name: take_screenshot
description: Capture a screenshot from a connected Meta Quest device via ADB. Returns the screenshot as an MCP image content block (mime_type 'image/jpeg' for the default Meta Cam path, 'image/png' for the screencap fallback). Default dimensions are 1024x1024; override with width/height. Use this when you need to see the current state of the device screen.

method.description: Screenshot capture method - 'metacam' uses Meta's camera service, 'screencap' uses Android's screencap as fallback
